definitionZh: 字体变异的 CSS 属性控制替代格言的使用. 这些备选格言可以用在@font-feature-values中定义的替代名称来引用 。
sourceDefinition: The font-variant-alternates CSS property controls the usage of alternate glyphs. These alternate glyphs may be referenced by alternative names defined in @font-feature-values.
